def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    returns = [1.5, -0.5, 3.2, -2.0, 0.8]
    n = len(returns)
    mean = sum(returns) / n

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    s2 = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in returns)
    s4 = sum((x - mean) ** 4 for x in returns)
    m2 = s2 / n
    m4 = s4 / n
    excess_kurtosis = (m4 / (m2 ** 2)) - 3

    # Return answer rounded to two decimal places
    return round(excess_kurtosis, 2)
